errorCodes.meaning: The community has no link to a VTA. Its identities can only be served by the community itself; its host's operator configures a link to publish elsewhere.
The community's VTA did not answer.
The community's VTA refused the read. Its own code and message are carried in `details`.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.

HostingServer.description: A did:webvh hosting server registered at the community's VTA, as that VTA reports it. Carries no credential.

id.description: The server's id at the VTA: the value that names it in the community's configuration.
